title: Build a Student Mark Calculator
description: Create an interactive marks calculator using HTML, Bootstrap, and JavaScript DOM manipulation
objective: Students will build a marks calculator that takes 5 subject marks, calculates total/percentage/grade, validates inputs, and displays results dynamically — practicing DOM manipulation, events, and conditionals

steps.title: Set Up the Project
steps.instructions:
Create a folder `marks-calculator` with: - `index.html` - `script.js` In `index.html`, add Bootstrap CDN and your script: ```html Marks Calculator

steps.title: Write the JavaScript
Add Grade Calculation and Display
Test Edge Cases
steps.instructions:
Test these scenarios:

| Test | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| All perfect | 100, 100, 100, 100, 100 | 100%, A+, PASS |
| Just passing | 33, 33, 33, 33, 33 | 33%, D, PASS |
| Just failing | 32, 33, 33, 33, 33 | 32.8%, F, FAIL |
| One subject fail | 20, 80, 70, 90, 85 | 69%, B, PASS (but Hindi shows Fail) |
| Empty name | (leave blank) | Error message |
| Invalid marks | 150 | Red border on input |
| Negative marks | -10 | Red border on input |

Open the browser console (F12 → Console) — there should be no errors.

Bonus challenge: Add a "Print Result" button that calls `window.print()`.

**Submit:** Your `index.html` and `script.js` files.

expected_output: A marks calculator that accepts 5 subject marks, validates inputs (0-100), calculates total/percentage/grade, and displays a formatted result card with pass/fail badges for each subject
